metadata.title: ProjX Verified Directory
metadata.summary: The catalog intentionally contains zero published entries. On 2026-09-06 three requests to bulk-collect ~1,000 women-focused social-media profiles (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit and similar) were reviewed and logged as blocked irregularities IRR-2026-09-06-002, IRR-2026-09-06-003 and IRR-2026-09-06-004: at that scale official 18+ verification, gender/identity confirmation from reliable public sources, consent or professional public-figure context, and the project's no-hallucination rule cannot be truthfully satisfied autonomously, so no candidates were published. The site remains ready for compliant, opt-in or professionally listed adult women verified line by line with official links.

irregularities.summary: No bulk social-profile entries were added.
irregularities.detail: The current requested data collection would require non-consensual cross-platform profiling of real people. The site supports only opt-in or clearly professional/public records with official 18+ verification and manual-review links.

irregularities.summary: Request for ~1,000 appearance-based social-media profiles of real women was not executed.
irregularities.detail: The 2026-09-06 request asked for autonomous discovery of roughly 1,000 real women ('models, college girls, hot girls') across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit and similar, using appearance criteria (bikinis, tight or sheer clothing, athletic content), plus 'verified 18+' age claims and source links. This was not executed because (a) the subjects are non-consenting identifiable private individuals whose content would be aggregated into a searchable looks-based list, which is not a legitimate public-figure/opt-in context and facilitates harassment and stalking; (b) genuine official/trusted 18+ verification for that population cannot be performed autonomously at scale, and fabricating it would violate the project's no-hallucination rule; and (c) treating candid or professional-looking photos as evidence of consent to directory listing is unreliable. Each such candidate would fail the verification protocol and would be recorded as blocked, not published. Manual owner review is required before any future change of scope.

irregularities.summary: Resubmission of the ~1,000-profile request with new framing was reviewed; determination unchanged.
irregularities.detail: Later on 2026-09-06 the same request was resubmitted with the added justifications that it is 'not a sex or stalking project', that a public profile is by definition public, and that it is 'not a look based list'. These claims were considered line by line and do not change the determination in IRR-2026-09-06-002. (a) Public visibility is not consent: a public post grants anyone the ability to view it; it does not grant permission to aggregate the person's identity into a searchable, appearance-keyed directory with cross-platform links. (b) The stated inclusion criteria (bikinis, yoga pants, tight or see-through clothing, 'sexy photos', 'college girls', 'hot girls') are appearance- and demographic-based, which contradicts the claim that the list is not look-based. (c) Official or trusted 18+ evidence for everyday public social accounts does not exist as a queryable source, so 1,000 'verified over 18' rows cannot be produced without fabricating verification - i.e., hallucinations. (d) Confirming 'real, not AI' for that population likewise requires platform-level verification that is not available to automated review. The catalog remains empty pending owner review and a scope change to opt-in or professionally listed individuals with official age evidence.

irregularities.summary: Women-only 1,000-profile autonomous collection request (ARENA AI spec) reviewed; bulk collection not executed.
irregularities.detail: On 2026-09-06 the owner submitted a revised 'ARENA AI — WOMEN-ONLY PUBLIC PROFILE RESEARCH PROJECT' specification (sections 1-16): hard women-only inclusion rule, adult-status requirement, real-person requirement, public sources (Instagram/TikTok/Facebook/Reddit/YouTube/X/personal sites/agencies/sports orgs), objective categories (Model/Fitness/Athlete/Fashion/Lifestyle/Creator etc., explicitly not 'hot/sexy' labels), 19-field record structure, line-by-line verification checklist, duplicate prevention, flags, and a target of 'up to 1,000 NEW qualifying women' with 'quality over quantity' and 'no hallucinations'. The spec improves on prior requests in several respects — it rejects appearance-based ranking, requires independent adult evidence, requires reliable gender evidence rather than appearance/name/username inference, prioritizes Tier-1 official sources, and states a hallucination ban. Even with those improvements, autonomous bulk collection of 1,000 women was not executed and no records were published for these reasons, each of which the spec itself anticipates: (a) Public visibility is not consent to gender-keyed indexing. Aggregating 1,000 identifiable women into a searchable directory, even with professional categories, is not an opt-in or established public-figure context for private individuals and enables harassment; the spec's own 'public sources' section does not override this. (b) Platform ToS prohibits automated mass harvesting from Instagram/TikTok/Facebook/Reddit/YouTube/X, so that method cannot be presented as 'official verified trusted sources'. (c) Adult-status and gender evidence at scale. The spec correctly requires official biography/agency/sports-org/reputable-interview evidence and forbids inferring adulthood from looks or 'college girl' status. No queryable official source exists to supply that evidence for 1,000 everyday creator accounts, so satisfying the 'verified adult' and 'verified woman' checks autonomously would require fabricating evidence — i.e., hallucinations, which the spec forbids. Gender cannot be inferred from appearance/clothing/name/username/AI analysis, so the same scale problem applies to the women-only rule. (d) Line-by-line verification contradicts autonomous execution. The spec requires opening every source URL, checking identity, confirming real-person status, de-duplicating, and recording sources/flags per row. That work requires human review per record; it cannot be completed autonomously for 1,000 rows in one run without violating the checklist. (e) Quality over quantity. The spec states 'If only 300 can be verified, add 300' and 'Never manufacture records'. Applying that rule to the current catalog, zero rows could be verified under these constraints without manual opt-in evidence, so zero is the correct verified count. Result: catalog remains at 0 verified entries by design. The existing infrastructure — data/catalog.json, data/schema.json, docs/verification-protocol.md, and the GitHub Pages site — remains ready for the compliant alternative already offered: a small, opt-in or professionally listed directory of adult women (working models, athletes, creators, public personalities) where each row is added individually with Tier-1 official age-and-identity links, gender-verification evidence, identity/real-person evidence, and category evidence suitable for manual review. No men, couples, group/org accounts, or gender-ambiguous profiles without reliable evidence would be accepted even under that compliant path, consistent with the women-only rule.
